title: Windrush
summary: Windrush adds recurring spell attacks as the fight progresses.
overview: Windrush adds recurring spell attacks as the fight progresses.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: At 70% health, Windrush begins using Stunning Strike, repeating every twenty seconds after the initial cast.
At 40% health, Mana Spectrum joins the rotation and repeats every fifteen seconds.
Allow for increasing pressure on the tank and the group in the final stages. The encounter has a thirty-minute depop timer once engaged.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
